items.question: Which goddess among Kamala and Bhuvaneshi is named Dhanada?
premises: Dhanada is named in connection with Kamala.
items.inference: The verse identifies Dhanada with Kamala and directs attention to Bhuvaneshi.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal relation between Kamala and Bhuvaneshi is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Of Kamala, indeed Dhanada; of Bhuvaneshi, hear, beloved.
